name: Lemon chicken & rice
instructions:
Cook the rice according to its packet.
Cut the chicken into strips and season to taste. Pan-fry in the olive oil until fully cooked.
Steam the broccoli until tender.
Add crushed garlic, lemon zest and juice to the chicken. Serve with the rice and broccoli.

name: Salmon tray bake
instructions:
Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the potatoes into small pieces and toss with olive oil and seasoning.
Roast the potatoes for about 25 minutes.
Add the salmon, tomatoes and lemon slices. Roast for another 12–15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Finish with fresh dill.

name: Red lentil bolognese
instructions:
Dice the onion and carrots. Soften in olive oil, then add crushed garlic.
Rinse the lentils and add to the pan with the tomatoes and enough water to simmer comfortably.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes, adding water as needed, until the lentils are tender. Season to taste.
Cook the pasta according to its packet and serve with the sauce.
